answer: Proof of non-occurrence shows that a particular event did not happen within a defined window, by presenting a complete, authenticated log of that window with no matching entry. A vine of log entries covers every moment, a jetty at the window's edge marks its boundary, and a hollow gap in the log would itself be evidence of tampering rather than proof. A Sybil farm cannot hide an event that did occur for many identities, because the log is committed in advance and audited as a whole, so omitting one entry breaks the chain of commitments.
